Interface FileLock

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface FileLock extends AutoCloseable
Represents a lock on a region of a file acquired through a FileChannel.

A lock remains valid until it is released by close() or its associated channel is closed, whichever occurs first. File locks are held on behalf of the entire Java virtual machine and are not suitable for coordinating access between threads in the same virtual machine.

Since:
25.5
